tests.name: server starts on a verified-free loopback port with fail-closed regenerated SceneIR
tests.independentSourceOfTruth: the child process stdout startup line and the live /api/status response — neither is produced by the test code
tests.whyNonCircular: the test only observes what the server itself prints and serves
tests.failureCaseDetected: bind not loopback / pid mismatch / SceneIR not regenerated / three pin broken

tests.measuredQuantity: HTTP statuses + body markers (canvas/diagnostics ids, module exports, three module size)
tests.independentSourceOfTruth: real local HTTP responses over the wire

tests.failureCaseDetected: any static file missing, wrong type, or the three pin route broken

tests.name: SceneIR endpoint serves the bounded index-derived regenerated data (pins + 62+4=66 + 14 associations + 9/5 texture statuses)

tests.independentSourceOfTruth: the pinned SHA256 identities + the predecessor-measured 62+4=66 / 14 / 9+5 accounting
tests.whyNonCircular: the endpoint content is compared to externally pinned hashes and counts, not to its own claim
tests.failureCaseDetected: stale/unpinned data, wrong counts, wire geometry inconsistent with its own counts

tests.name: synthetic malicious paths (../, absolute, encoded traversal, unconfigured root, unknown route) all DENIED with explicit errors
tests.measuredQuantity: per-request status + explicit error class + no NIF/BNT payload markers in the body
tests.independentSourceOfTruth: the wire responses themselves (raw paths sent un-normalized over real HTTP)
tests.whyNonCircular: the server code under test is exercised through its public socket; denial classes are read from its own JSON errors

tests.name: malformed percent/null-byte URLs refused; non-GET methods refused (read-only API)
tests.measuredQuantity: status + explicit error class per request
tests.whyNonCircular: the requests exercise the server parser and method gate directly

tests.name: bounded server lifecycle: own PID/port recorded, process stopped, port FREED
tests.measuredQuantity: exit code + port rebind probe after kill
tests.independentSourceOfTruth: child exit event + a fresh bind/close probe of the same port
tests.whyNonCircular: port freeness is measured by the OS accept path, not by trust in the kill call

T7_API_AND_PATH_DENIAL.denial_design_note: Denial is BY CONSTRUCTION: static routes are exact allowlist maps (the request URL never becomes a filesystem path); the only prefixed route (the pinned three package) is jail-checked (no "..", no backslash, no %, resolve+startsWith the package root); unknown routes return 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND. Malformed percent / NUL byte -> 400; non-GET/HEAD -> 405 (read-only API). The whole BNT and the source trees are not reachable through any route.

honest_notes: One targeted repair pass was used during this phase (allowed): (a) T8 initially crashed on authored2.asset (the builder returns {registry,instances}) — fixed to read the shared asset record; (b) the app boot function was defined but NOT invoked (headless DOM stayed PENDING; request log proved the SceneIR fetch never happened) — boot() call added with a .catch that sets an honest ERROR data-load-status; (c) a PowerShell Set-Content round-trip double-encoded 4 compat/*.js files (CP1252 mojibake) — reversed by byte-accurate re-decode and normalized to pure ASCII; all three repairs preserved and re-measured green (13/13).

T7's recorded lifecycle belongs to the FINAL run (port 8140, pid 2340). The intermediate run used port 8264 (findFreePort skipped 8140 — a diagnostic server orphan was holding it at that moment; the orphan was stopped and 8140 re-verified free before the final run; no foreign port was ever touched).

The headless Edge stderr excerpt contains Edge identity-service noise (headless profile has no credentials) — unrelated to the app; no page errors occurred (module chain + /api/sceneir/218757 all 200 in the request log).

loadStatus READY means the real-browser boot COMPLETED: WebGLRenderer created (SwiftShader), SceneIR fetched, client pin checks + world-transform cross-checks + all 14 geometry fingerprint re-hashes passed, ASSET MODE mounted.

No proprietary payloads are committed: the served wire SceneIR (incl. geometry arrays) is regenerated at server startup from the pinned container and exists only in memory/loopback; raw/ contains only transcripts, machine summaries, the app's own DOM dump and bounded JSON artifacts.
